stage: bounded development source verification; no origin or pilot acceptance
target_basis: first assignment in saved historical development selection; no redraw or current-price selection
historical_selection_claim: reference for fixed diagnostic target only; not refreshed, reverified or admitted as prospective selection
quote_policy_basis: explicit development receipt-time ceiling; no calibrated freshness or predictive claim
storage_preflight_basis: 2 GiB reserve plus 128 MiB for source and computation; existing per-source and computation caps remain binding
run_only_after: D046 self-review, full isolated tests, coherent commit and draft PR update
report: exact plan/build/script hashes, source and computation roots, actual request/read/computation/durability clocks, failures, source/quote states, retained/raw bytes, elapsed time and peak memory; no raw payload printing
followup: independent read-only computation verification at original cutoff; preserve every failed attempt and do not chase a valid quote
